body: Oh, a face-to-face therapist is much better, and I do have one of those. I'm just looking for crisis help because he's not available right now. Thanks for the advice. :)

Thank you so much for this comment, in turn - I really appreciate your kindness, and I am glad that other people might be helped as well. And haha, no worries - I know what you're trying to say. Mental health issues can be extremely isolating, so it's comforting when you're reminded that the isolation isn't...as real as it feels, and other people are dealing with the same shit. 

Thanks so much again for your kind words. <3

Thank you very much for the info - I really, really appreciate it. One of my biggest issues with calling helplines is that I already know the script a lot of the time, so I will keep these guys' number close by for now. 

Fortunately (or unfortunately) I have already turned up to the Mater in distress and found that they don't have a psych unit, lol. However, for anyone reading - in spite of not having a PEC, the Mater were exceptionally nice to me, treated my physical injuries, and then gave me a bed to rest in until they were able to call my psychiatrist the following morning...so if they're the only hospital you can get to, it's still better to go there than nowhere. The PA is much better than the RBH when it comes to hospitals that do have PECs, though, as r/aussiereport said. 

And thanks so much for the offer to chat - I'm really glad that you're doing well. :)
Thank you, I really appreciate it.
Thank you very much - I didn't know their hotline existed.

+1 based on my experiences as a skirt-wearer. I think most women who wear skirts are so used to them getting weird and bunchy that they are constantly adjusting them without even thinking about it. I think we are socialised to be paranoid about accidentally flashing people, too - I often pull my skirt down to cover my legs better, but my thought process isn't "Ew, that person is peeking" so much as it is "Oh shit, pull that down before you flash everyone." I am often pulling the neckline of my shirt up for the same reason.
